cases.output: Domain-perspective glossary proposal with confirmation before creating new repo files
cases.completion: Defines each term from its business meaning and invariants rather than database column types, identifies synonyms to retire, checks existing documentation paths first, and asks before creating a new GLOSSARY.md file.
